profile_text.body:
Saltillo's website centers on TouchChat, an iOS app for people who have difficulty speaking with their natural voice. The company describes it as a dynamic communication solution with customizable features and a range of vocabularies, languages, and voices, aimed at a variety of communication disorders. The site highlights head tracking, which uses facial recognition on newer iPad Pro and iPhone models to follow head and face movements, alongside built-in switch scanning and touch access. It also notes iOS Split View for running two apps side by side, and points users to three different TouchChat apps on the App Store.

The held record lists TouchChat under education and research AI, with word prediction as its AI feature and use as an AAC app for students with communication needs and speech-language pathologists. A note says the price of TouchChat HD is $149.99 or more on the App Store, drawn from a state assistive technology program list dated 2022, and cautions that the price comes from that 2022 list. The same note states the product was found in research for The AI Ready School and was not independently verified, and that privacy was not verified.

No lawsuits, MCP servers, or other filings are recorded for Saltillo.
